head: feature/billing-demo-collections
title: Draft: Billing collect and close workspace composition
body:
Bills to collect and cash closing now share the demo's Collect and close layout: existing permission-filtered route tabs, contextual guidance and actual totals. The collection table keeps owed and its action visible, with the existing financial breakdown in expandable details. Financial scripts, backend rules, grants and migrations are unchanged.

Owner requested all existing work be committed and preserved as draft PRs before handover; this is not merge approval or full-demo acceptance.

Validation: production build and initial full typecheck passed; final scoped lint/diff checks passed. Synthetic populated, readonly and validation flows were checked at390/1440 light/dark. Staff independently reviewed the exact four-file patch and12 states, plus expanded detail/error views, and independently passed the3 new component tests.

BLOCKED:96/98 focused tests pass. Two existing BIL23 layout assertions still expect nine table columns and Approved pay later as a column header. The exact proposed changes are retained separately and have NOT been applied or approved. No failing expectation has been weakened silently. CI is expected to reflect this unresolved gate.

Remaining demo work: search/age filters, remaining Billing groups, cash-history composition and complete interaction/state parity. Existing header/pagination target-size debt remains. The previous styling slice is a separate draft and overlaps CashClosings.vue; reconcile deliberately before merging.

Local review/evidence: /workspace/kpone-validation/billing-demo-initial/REVIEW.md, INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.md, PROPOSED-existing-assertions.patch and manifest.json. Frozen source patch SHA256 c03483e95c90cfbbb1eca3eae084316bfd797c5068cd334cc4bc39628a3f7c52.
